One of the things that blows my mind on r/BWF is how piss poor people are at finding stuff to exercise on. Several times a week people post threads saying "HAY GUISE, I'm gonna be in a hotel for a few days, won't be taking my doorway pull up bar! HOW 2 DO PULL UPS???" ...And then if you suggest they actually go outside and find stuff to work out on, you actually eat downvotes.

People unironically downvote you for suggesting BWF people should improvise.

It's just perplexing, just like it's perplexing that they've got whole legions of people actually stuck believing that if you are not making progress towards a planche or other highlighted party tricks, you are not fit.

With that in mind, I wanted to start a thread to specifically discuss how to find stuff to work out on.

A lot of this will be really obvious to some of you, but this is to get minds moving, especially to users coming from that other hellhole.

Pull ups:

  • Rafters
  • Doorways
  • Walls (see "cat hang pull ups" )
  • L-sit pull ups from all kinds of unsuitable/short rails and grips
  • Trees. Note that many options open up if you grab things like this.

Rows:

  • On horizontal railing
  • Underhand grip, underneath tables
  • By laying a broom handle across two stools, chairs etc
  • By hanging from a pull up height bar and finding something to prop your feet on. Note that the parallel grip could open up options again.

Dips:

  • Tables
  • Chairs
  • Inner corners of counter tops
  • Straight railing. Learn to do straight bar dips.
  • Note that learning to do them with feet tucked under or in an L-sit can enhance versatility. If you can do straight bar dips from an L-sit, you will never lack something to do dips on.
  • The tops of retaining walls (my favorite)

Step ups, decline push ups and similar:

  • Rocks
  • Chairs
  • Couch arms
  • Retaining walls
  • Stair cases
  • Tree stumps

Wall supported handstand push ups:

  • Walls (seriously, who is short on walls?)
  • Trees
  • Light poles or any vertical pole
  • Learn to do them free standing

Most everything else there is to do can be done on the ground.

Once again, this is just to get minds moving. Some people out there might need it.
